description: Convert a CGPA to a percentage using a named, sourced rule. Rules: common_9_5 (default estimate), vtu_2022_onwards, vtu_2015_2017_2018, gtu, anna_university_departments, proportional (any scale). Different rules give different percentages for the same CGPA.

scale_max.description: Only used by the "proportional" rule. Default 10.

name: convert_cgpa_to_percentage
title: Convert CGPA to percentage
